mapper.select: SELECT v.`id`, v.`shop_id`, v.`activity_id`, v.`title`, v.`sub_title`, v.`rules`, v.`pay_value`, v.`actual_value`, v.`type`, sv.`stock` , sv.begin_time , sv.end_time FROM tb_voucher v LEFT JOIN tb_seckill_voucher sv ON v.id = sv.voucher_id LEFT JOIN tb_activity a ON v.activity_id = a.id WHERE v.shop_id = #{shopId} AND v.status = 1 AND (v.activity_id IS NULL OR a.status = 2)
